selection_narrative: Cohort N=250 was selected based on the maximum-development-data principle, as it represents the largest registered training sample size available before opening the locked-test partition. It was not chosen based on inner-validation scores (where N=100 exhibited a slightly higher mean). This prospective policy was frozen post model development but strictly prior to locked-test unsealing.
integrity_and_leakage_gates: Verify locked-test source count equals 343 unique source_ids.
Verify exactly two samples per source_id (1 authentic + 1 ai_edited).
Verify exact label pair {0, 1} for every source_id.
Verify 0 overlap between locked-test sources and development_train (250 sources).
Verify 0 overlap between locked-test sources and inner_validation (91 sources).
Verify zero write paths from Stage 1/2 outputs to dataset inputs.
Verify dataset archive, content, and manifest hashes match canonical bundle metadata.
Verify all 5 checkpoint SHA-256 hashes match candidate_checkpoint_binding.json before evaluation.
Verify network isolation is active (0 external bytes transferred).
Verify zero package or model weight downloads during evaluation.
Verify fail-closed behavior on runtime crash after predictions exist (no silent retry).
